note: Deterministic reproduction package: generator version + seed are stored per record. A rule change ships a new version (DRIP/2.0 on change), never a silent edit.

generators.seed_scheme: random.Random(10_000_000 + i) for model i (0-based); ARCH/MATS/WIDTHS/SCALES choice order fixed
model number N (1..1000000) is the input; random seeds map via PCIDENT.seedToModelNumber (mulberry32)
generators.note: Computed on demand in the browser. Nothing stored, nothing slow.
